scenarios.expected: The repository shows permitted Documents and links to the correct owners/Versions. Hidden owners do not leak through results or filters; archived/empty result behavior matches the guide.
scenarios.actual: 9 browser steps passed, following the article as legal team member: Documents opens the flat repository and Recent lists at most five newest current Versions; the Owner filter narrows to each owner kind this role may reach; Record narrows to one owning record and unlocks a Folder filter; a Knowledge owner is offered no Folder filter, and the seam refuses one; Format, Kind, Uploader, Counterparty and the two dates all have to match; Recent is hidden while filters are active and returns when they are cleared; opening a row lands on its owning record with the current Version selected; a record this reader cannot reach never appears, by filter or by direct link; Show archived reveals archived rows and Restore brings one back.
